title: Encountering Humanities Research
description: An introduction to the mission and vision of the Humanities. Explores the subject matter, range, and purpose of current Humanities research. Features guest speakers from the UVic library, research centres, and Humanities research projects. Includes one 10-hour placement in a Humanities Research project.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HUMA 180 or HUMA 295 (if taken in the same topic).
High school GPA of 90+ or equivalent and permission of the Humanities Faculty required for admission.
